info.parent: The Ultimate Stage of the Pirate

descriptions.notStarted: My training as a Pirate has reached its limit. Is this as far as I can go? I should go find #b#p2020013##k who helped me make my 3rd level advancement and ask about life as a Pirate.
descriptions.inProgress: #b#p2020013##k is telling me to go talk to #b#p2081500##k, the Priest of the Minar Forest, to find the secrets of the final path of a Pirate.
descriptions.completed: #b#p2081500##k is telling me that he will teach me how to gain the greatest power of the Pirate.
